messages:
Maria (infra): Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — dropping a short action log so we can lock owners and timelines. PTAL.
Dan (sre): Thanks. Can you paste the condensed list of what we decided? I missed part of the handoff.
Maria (infra): Summary: 1) hard quota guardrails + alerting for dedicated pools; 2) scheduler tuning to avoid bin-packing spikes; 3) headroom dashboard + scheduled capacity ramp runbook; 4) recurring surge detector to trigger preemptive scale-ups. Kept each as 2-4 week workstreams.
Ashley (sched): For (2) I think the immediate win is lowering the default pod packing factor and making the preemption threshold more conservative. I can prototype change in staging this week.
Leo (capacity): For (3) I'll own the dashboard and runbook. Can we aim to have an initial version by 2026-04-10? That gives us two sprints to validate signals.
Maria (infra): Sounds good. Draft action items below — please confirm or adjust owners/deadlines. I'll run the follow-ups weekly until closed.

ACTIONS (short):
A1. Quota guardrails + alerting (block/softquota + pager): owner = Dan (sre); due = 2026-04-03; notes = implement hard rejects at 95% of reserved pool, add PagerDuty escalation if >2mins.
A2. Scheduler tuning (packing/preemption thresholds): owner = Ashley (sched); due = 2026-03-30; notes = reduce default packing factor from 0.85 -> 0.7 for GPU pools, tune preempt threshold from 0.9 -> 0.95.
A3. Headroom dashboard + ramp playbook: owner = Leo (capacity); due = 2026-04-10; notes = surface headroom by region, per-model queue length, proactive ramp command in runbook.
A4. Recurring surge detector (anomaly -> warm pools): owner = Maria (infra) + OpsBot integration; due = 2026-04-17; notes = light-touch detector using 5m token rate + trend, trigger warm pool + paging on sustained 10%+ growth.
A5. Post-release smoke test and canary for autoscale changes: owner = Ashley; due = release window; notes = test scenario scripts + perf regression check.

Dan (sre): I can take A1. I'll put a PR in for the alert rules and a simple policy that rejects new allocs when pool usage >95%. Also adding a runbook snippet.
Ashley (sched): Confirmed A2/A5. I can prototype change in staging today and run a controlled e2e tomorrow. I'll add the scheduler config diff here:
```
# staging scheduler snippet
packing_factor: 0.7
preemption_threshold: 0.95
max_bin_fill: 0.9
```
Leo (capacity): A3 acknowledged. I'll start a dashboard in Grafana and wire the headroom metric: (free_gpus / reserved_gpus) by region. Will share link by next check-in.
Maria (infra): For A4 we should keep the detector conservative initially — only trigger warm pools (no aggressive spinups) and post an OpsBot annotation. OpsBot, can you add a tag to incidents created by the detector so we can filter them?
OpsBot: automated-message: added tag "surge-detector" to incidents created by automated triggers. I will attach recent anomaly history to the incident thread.
Dan (sre): Two quick clarifications: 1) Does A1's 95% threshold exclude queued preemptible jobs? 2) Who owns verifying that dedicated vs shared pools have different policies?
Maria (infra): Good call. A1 excludes preemptible/spot allocations (those live in separate pools). I'll update the A1 note. Ownership: Dan owns dedicated pools policy, Leo owns cross-checks for shared vs dedicated mapping.
Ashley (sched): ETA note: staging run will finish by 2026-03-27 and I'll post perf numbers. If numbers look good we can roll to canary 2026-03-29.
Leo (capacity): Dashboard ETA 2026-04-06 (soft) / 2026-04-10 (hard). I'll add historical week-over-week headroom panels and a per-model heatmap for queue length.
Maria (infra): I'm adding weekly check-ins: Mondays 10:30 PT. I'll update calendar invites. We'll use this thread for day-to-day notes.
Dan (sre): I'll open the A1 PR today and link it here.
Ashley (sched): Put me down for the 2026-03-29 canary. I'll also draft smoke test scripts and share.
Maria (infra): Outstanding: confirm PR links and runbook snippets in this thread. Once PRs merge, Ops will coordinate a canary window.
Leo (capacity): A couple of follow-ups: can we add a retrospective marker to recurring incidents so we can quantify how many surge events we prevented post-work? I can own the metric.
Maria (infra): Yes — add metric 'surge_events_prevented' and we'll report it quarterly.
Dan (sre): Ack. I'll post the PR link: https://git.redwood/example/pr/4321
Ashley (sched): PR for scheduler prototype: https://git.redwood/example/pr/4334
Maria (infra): Thanks. I'll update the action list in the postmortem doc and close items as we see green checks. Next check-in Monday 10:30 PT. :white_check_mark:
Leo (capacity): :thumbsup: will sync dashboards and invite product for visibility next week.
OpsBot: automated-message: incident-followup-tracker updated, assigned owners: Dan, Ashley, Leo, Maria. Next automated check-in scheduled in 7 days.
